01

Player limits and host responsibilities

  • 2 to 20 players per room.

    Couples can share a single device.

  • One host creates the room.

    No sign-up or email needed. The host owns the room until they leave or delete it.

  • Players join with a code.

    No account needed for guests — just the 6-character room code and a display name.

  • Host starts the party.

    The room moves Lobby → Pre-Night Show (only if the line-up isn’t out yet) → Predictions Open → Voting Live → Final Results. The host starts it from the Lobby; every later phase change happens automatically.

  • Host powers are limited.

    Besides starting the party, the host can open the tiebreak vote for a tied trophy and delete the room. Nobody can reset quiz rounds, void duels, edit scores or remove players.

02

Phases

The room moves through five phases in a fixed order, plus an optional tiebreak at the end. The host starts the party from the Lobby; after that the app moves the room on automatically as the official show data comes in — nobody has to press anything mid-show.

#PhaseTypical durationWhat’s locked
1LobbyUntil the host taps Start the Party!Predictions, quiz, duels
2Pre-Night ShowOnly until the Grand Final line-up is published — usually skipped on final nightPredictions
3Predictions OpenFrom party start until voting opens — all through the songsNothing — predictions, quiz and duels are all open
4Voting LiveFrom the start of voting until the official results are finalPredictions, quiz, duels
5Final ResultsFinal 30 min of showEverything except the tie vote and sudden death
+Tiebreak (optional)60-second room vote, then a 3-question sudden-death match if the room chooses itEverything else
03

Prediction rules

  • Top 5. An ordered list of five countries you predict will finish 1–5 in the official combined jury + televote ranking.
  • Worst 5. An ordered list of five countries you predict will finish at the bottom (last-place country = position 1 in your Worst 5).
  • No overlap. A country can appear in only one of your two lists.
  • Ordering matters. Exact-position match scores 50; correct list at the wrong position scores 20; outside the list scores 0.
  • Hard lock when voting opens. When the room moves to Voting Live, lists lock automatically — no edits and no late entries.
  • Late joiners can still enter predictions, play quiz and duel until voting opens.
04

Quiz rules

  • Players start each round. 3 rounds of 10 questions, played at your own pace.
  • 4 options per question. Single-select, 15-second timer.
  • Tiered scoring by response time. 12 points (≤3s), 8 points (≤7s), 4 points (≤15s); 0 for wrong or timeout.
  • No question repeats per player across the entire night, including duels.
  • Quiz locks when voting opens. Quiz and duels run side by side from party start until Voting Live.
05

Duel rules

  • Available from party start until voting opens. Open in Pre-Night Show and Predictions Open; locked in the Lobby and from Voting Live onward.
  • 3 questions per duel. Same questions for both players, answered in private.
  • 12-second timer per question. Score = 12 minus elapsed seconds; wrong or timeout = 0.
  • Per-pair limit. Each of you can challenge the other once, and the loser of a duel can request one rematch. Once a rematch exists between two players, they can’t duel again — you cannot grind one opponent.
  • Refusals are limited. No point penalty, but each player can refuse only 2 challenges per night in rooms of up to 5 players, 3 with 6–10, 4 with 11–15 and 5 with 16 or more. Refused rematches count too.
  • Winner picks Steal or Double. There is no flat win bonus. Steal moves your duel score (your 3-answer total) from the loser to you — capped at what they have, and unavailable if they have 0 points. Double adds twice your duel score to you, and the loser keeps their points. Equal totals are a tie: no winner, no points move.
06

Trophy rules

Five trophies are awarded at the Final phase. One player can win multiple categories.

  • Champion — highest total points across all phases combined.
  • Thief — most points taken via duel Steal effects.
  • Duelist — most duels won across the night.
  • Oracle — highest prediction-only score (Top 5 + Worst 5 totals).
  • Guru — most correct quiz answers across all quiz rounds (duel answers don’t count).

Co-winners (2–5 players tied on a category) split a single trophy unless the room votes for sudden death.

07

Sudden-death tiebreak

For any tied trophy category, the host opens a 60-second tiebreak vote — the room chooses Accept (co-winners share the trophy) or Sudden Death. Sudden Death only goes ahead if it wins a clear majority with at least 3 votes cast. If it does, the tied players enter a 3-question trivia match; most correct answers wins — speed breaks ties. If the vote stays with Accept, all tied players share the trophy.

Host opens the vote

Once results are final, the host opens the tiebreak vote for each tied category from the trophy screen. If the host doesn’t open it, tied players share the trophy by default.

08

Disconnect policy

  • Auto-rejoin. A reconnect banner appears the moment connection drops; one tap restores state with no manual rejoin.
  • Points preserved. Predictions, quiz score, and duel results stay locked to your player slot through any drop.
  • Active duels resolve fairly. If you disconnect mid-duel, your unanswered questions score 0; the duel resolves on whoever has more points.
  • No bench penalty. Quiz rounds and duels you miss while away cannot be back-filled, but no points are deducted.
09

Edge cases

  • Player leaves mid-show. Slot frees up; their banked points stay frozen on the leaderboard so the rest of the room is unaffected.
  • Host deletes the room. Session ends for everyone. A confirmation prompt prevents accidents; deletion is irreversible.
  • Cheating. Multi-device or AI-assisted answering: the app can’t detect or undo it, so the room settles it by house rules.
  • Result entry error. Hosts can’t edit scores. Official results are imported automatically, and re-running the import pulls in any official correction.
  • Multiple rooms per host. Allowed: a host can create up to 10 rooms an hour.
